question: Who signed the Poona Pact of 1932 on behalf of Mahatma Gandhi, as he was imprisoned at the time?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Pt. Madan Mohan Malviya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Poona Pact** was an agreement signed on **September 24, 1932**, between **Mahatma Gandhi** and **Dr. B.R. Ambedkar**.
 
• This agreement was related to the issue of **separate electorates** for the depressed classes (Scheduled Castes).
 
• It was signed at Yerwada Central Jail, Pune</s
